arguments.text: Good start. Settle now, long race, find your rhythm.

6 km, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back, push of current/wind flips each leg. Goal: even shaft power near sustainable_shaft_power_w (about 150 W pod), spend the reserve by the finish, final sprint about 400-500 m out. Avoid ground-pace targets (they flip with current). 1) Start was 217 W pod: eased at 60 s; check it settled by 2-3 min. 2) Test CP: at steady effort near CP, HR levelling = below CP, HR climbing = above CP; use measure() on steady stretches. 3) Watch push_local vs push_along for drag (weed -> clear_rudder) or pod drift (pod vs HR vs speed). 4) Finish: cue finish around 400-500 m to go if reserve allows.

EXPERIMENT started ~race 385 s on leg 2 (back, push -0.32): rate +5 spm 100 s then -5 spm 100 s at same effort. Baseline: race 325-374 back, pod 149 W, rate 64.5, GPS 2.656, share 0.696. After it: measure the two segments (skip first ~20 s of each) with share=0.696 and compare GPS speed vs prediction; keep the rate that gives more speed per pod watt. Pacing idea: back legs are upstream (incl. last leg 6) - spend leftover reserve there, final sprint on leg 6.

arguments.text: 6 km, 6 legs of 1000 m; legs 1,3,5 out (push +0.33 helps), legs 2,4,6 back (push -0.32, upstream; finish leg is upstream). Rate test done: natural rate ~64.5 is best, do not change rate. CP pod ~147 W (HR near level at 148-150). Pacing: hold ~148-150 W pod on legs 3-5; spend the reserve on the upstream finish leg 6 (a joule spent upstream buys ~20 % more time than downstream): about +5 % from 1000 m to go, then finish cue ~300 m out if reserve > ~15 %. Keep checking HR trend: climbing >1.5 bpm/min at steady ~148 W => CP lower, ease. Watches slow_for_power / fast_for_power flag drag (weed -> clear_rudder test) or pod drift (check HR vs pod).

arguments.text: Wind behind now. Ease a touch this leg, save it for upwind.

Race 707 s: radio says south wind 8-12 kn filling in (helps out legs heading north, hurts back legs incl. finish leg 6). push_local on leg 3 already +0.42 vs +0.33 leg 1. Strategy: per joule, effort upstream buys ~1/v_ground more time (about 30 % more than downstream). Piece -4 % for 240 s on leg 3 (out) to refill a little; then on leg 4 (back) piece about +5 % for ~300 s; leg 6 spend the rest + finish. Computer prices -6 %/270 s as -1.41 kJ (boat units), +6 %/300 s as +2.52 kJ, both ~neutral in still water.

arguments.text: Race 747 s: fast_for_power alert on leg 3 (push_local +0.50 vs +0.33 on leg 1). Most likely the south wind (radio) not pod drift: HR 166 at pod 141 fits the -4 % piece. Test on leg 4: wind => back-leg push_local more negative (~-0.45); pod reading low => back-leg push_local LESS negative. Boat-derived reserve (9 %) is misled by the lagging push fit: trust pod reserve (33 %).
